images.caption: 500px provided description: I shot this while out  hiking in Algonquin Provincial Park with my wife and her sister. I didn't have tripod with me, so I   found some rocks and braced the camera so that it would be steady for the slow shutter speed that I needed.  I treated the final image with the Orton effect for additional affect. [#Provincial Parks ,#Waterfalls ,#Orton effect]
